title: Build a Product Card with the Box Model
description: Create a styled card component using padding, margin, border, and box-sizing.
problemStatement:
Given the HTML snippet, write the CSS to style it as a modern product card. HTML: ```html

SpeedRunner X

Lightweight running shoe with responsive cushioning.

$129.99
``` Requirements: - Apply the universal box‑sizing reset before any other styles. - The `.product-card`: - Maximum width 350px. - Background white. - Rounded corners (10px). - A subtle shadow (`box-shadow`). - 20px padding inside. - 15px margin around the card (to separate from other cards). - The `.product-img` should have: - Width 100% of the card (so it stretches, padding will prevent touching edges). - Border-radius 10px 10px 0 0 (to match the card top corners). Actually the card has padding, so img inside padding. To achieve edge‑to‑edge top corners, we could use negative margin but let's keep simple: just apply border-radius to the top corners of the img, and card padding ensures spacing. That's fine. - `.product-info` should have: - Top margin of 15px to separate from the image. - `.product-name`: - No margin on top, bottom 8px. - Font size 1.4rem. - `.product-desc`: - Margin bottom 15px. - Colour #666. - `.product-price`: - Bold. - Display block (so button goes to new line). - Margin bottom 10px. - `.btn-buy`: - Background #1e90ff. - Text white. - Padding 10px 20px. - No border. - Rounded corners (5px). - Cursor pointer. All spacing should be set with margins/paddings; no extra divs. Use shorthand where appropriate.
hints: For the card margin, use the shorthand `margin: 15px;`.
expectedOutput: A CSS file that styles the card as described, with proper spacing and a box‑sizing reset.
